_comment: Locks the user has reported, by Sleeper player id. Sleeper's public API does not expose locks: starters_points shows each starter's latest game (sometimes late) whether he is locked or not -- Durant and Lillard, locked 10/21, showed live scores during their 10/23 games, and Kawhi, locked at 48.5, showed his next game's 34 after it. So this file is the only source of lock status. Updated when the user reports a lock; entries count only for their week.
